_howto: Each look: { name, color (yellow|red|cyan|magenta|blue|green|ink|ink-dim), file (graded export), base (log / ungraded input revealed by the wipe handle), desc (optional caption) }. Each pair is its own shot, so each look carries its OWN base. Top-level 'base' stays empty (only used as a shared fallback when every look uses the same frame). Drop a -graded.jpg + -log.jpg pair into this folder and add an entry below.
